findings.cause: Neither Status: ok nor an ID absent from before-snapshots proves that this invocation created the discovered task. The pre/post interval admits noncooperating Android launches.
triggering_sequence: Before snapshots contain no Settings task.
Another Android actor creates Settings task T after those snapshots.
The observation start reuses or adds an Activity to T.
A successful ACK plus T absent-before permits registration and claim.
Current cleanup removes T although task creation was not proved to belong to this invocation.
findings.required_boundary: Do not start an automatic-cleanup observation without actual selected-framework new-task authority. Do not promote a snapshot candidate, caller JSON, generic ACK, or host flock into task ownership.
findings.reported_fix_plan_not_yet_reviewed: Owner plans unconditional public daemon/native rejection until selected-framework new-task authority exists; retain candidate/cleanup prototype only under cfg(test).

findings.cause: The durable pending marker was checked only by Settings acquisition. Other daemon mutations bypassed it, and the existing external helper took only the shared flock.
triggering_sequence: Settings start or instrumentation outcome remains unknown and creates pending state.
A subsequent non-Settings daemon mutation is submitted, or the daemon exits and its flock is released.
An entry that does not check pending can perform another Android action while prior Android work is unresolved.
findings.required_boundary: Every applicable daemon mutation must deny durable pending, including after restart. Cooperating external consumers must check the same marker while holding their existing shared flock. Reacquiring a separate flock inside a daemon entry invoked by a lock-holding helper is not a compatible substitute.
findings.reported_fix_plan_not_yet_reviewed: Owner plans all-daemon-mutation pending admission and a separate narrow consumer patch; no installed helper change yet.

reviewed_controls_without_new_defect: unknown start or ACK retains scope and does not remove a task
instrumentation timeout, malformed result or unproved restoration keeps helper unsettled
host command cgroup retirement does not settle Android instrumentation
pending file and directory are synced before start
unresolved Drop retains the open-file-description flock and pending marker
business deadline reserves 25 seconds from the same absolute lease
command deadline is min(business, original lease, now+20s)
cleanup uses original lease; final readbacks are bounded by min(original, now+8s)
retirement can spend up to two additional seconds but expired output is rejected
removal is sent once; ambiguous removal is not retried
limits: No new ordinary tests were run by the reviewer.
The owner's reported 78 ordinary controls are not Android/UI qualification.
The 117-test production foundations do not transfer qualification to later source generations.
No production caller or Running promotion was proved for the reviewed seccomp/readiness modules.
A source gate can eliminate the unsafe entry while leaving the real Settings capability blocked; it does not complete application qualification.
